title: Local C¹ retraction onto a C² submanifold with ‖Dπ(x)‖ ≤ 1 + c|x − y|
lean_statement: ∀ (P d : ℕ) (U N : Set (Euclid P)) (y : Euclid P), IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 d N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → y ∈ N ∩ U → ∃ (r c : ℝ) (proj : Euclid P → Euclid P), 0 < r ∧ 0 ≤ c ∧ closedBall y r ⊆ U ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ 1 proj (ball y r) ∧ MapsTo proj (ball y r) N ∧ (∀ x ∈ N ∩ ball y r, proj x = x) ∧ (∀ x ∈ N ∩ ball y r, ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace N x, fderiv ℝ proj x v = v) ∧ ∀ x ∈ ball y r, ‖fderiv ℝ proj x‖ ≤ 1 + c * dist x y
